Source Monster

Monster: Somnacanth | CR: 10 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Critical Status (Incapacitate). Whenever you critically hit with this weapon, the target creature must make a @Check[constitution|dc:14] saving throw. On a failed save the target is @condition[incapacitated] until the end of its next turn.

Armor Effect

While you are attuned to this armor you can speak its command word as an action to cause water to pour onto the ground from it filling the space in a 15-foot radius around you for 1 minute. The area moves with you and is difficult terrain for any creature, other than you, that doesn't have an innate swim speed. Speaking the command word again causes the water to stop flowing from you. You can use this property a number of times equal to half of your proficiency bonus (rounded down), regaining expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Tags: mechanic:critical, mechanic:condition, mechanic:saving-throw, type:offensive, mechanic:difficult-terrain, mechanic:long-rest, type:utility
